title: LANDauer Varian TrueBeam 10 MV 40x40 measured PDD and crossplane profiles
source_document: Sample Clinical Databook, Landauer Cancer Institute - Jackson, WY, Varian TrueBeam #9999, 2020

measurement_contract.pdd: Open-field CAX depth-dose scan, 100 cm SSD; PTW 31021 Semiflex 3D 0.070cc; PDF reports scans collected for 3,6,10,30,40 cm square fields.
measurement_contract.crossplane: 40x40 crossplane tabular profiles at dmax, 5, 10, 20, 30 cm; the databook states 40x40 profiles were collected at 80 cm SSD and converted to 100 cm SSD in PTW Beamscan.
measurement_contract.data_processing: Databook states photon PDD scans smoothed once and interpolated to 1 mm spacing; open-field profiles shifted to CAX 50% lines, symmetrized and interpolated.

extraction_notes: PDD and crossplane values transcribed directly from machine-readable PDF text tables; no graph digitization. PDD table exposed in the PDF is retained exactly without extrapolation.
